shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure rendered in low relief on a tall vertical monument
elaborate multi-tiered headdress or crown above the head
dense small ornamental/glyph-like blocks and scroll motifs filling the field
circular disc or medallion ornament on the body
banded horizontal element crossing the lower body
justification: Both surfaces show a single dominant anthropomorphic figure in shallow relief on a tall vertical monument, crowned by a broad, compartmented headdress with plume-like projections and surrounded by dense small block-like ornamental signs, with a disc ornament on the body and a horizontal banded element lower down. The clearest difference is organisation: A is a three-dimensional figural boulder where the relief follows the body's own contours in a strictly frontal, symmetrical layout, whereas B is a flat slab whose figure and headdress are set beside vertical columns of separate ornamental panels.
